dedupe_keys.name: openfacades building attribute and caption enrichment from street view imagery with vision language models

description: OpenFACADES is an open-source framework that enriches building profiles with objective attributes and semantic descriptions by combining crowdsourced building data and street view imagery with large vision-language models. Given a bounding box and a Mapillary API key, it retrieves building footprints and panoramic images, uses isovist analysis to link them, detects target buildings in panoramas, reprojects and filters them to good single-building views, and then applies fine-tuned InternVL models (1B and 2B released) to label building type, surface material, number of floors and building age and to write captions. The repository has Colab tutorials, a fine-tuning guide and a training dataset on Hugging Face, and lists follow-on uses such as graph neural network attribute prediction; the method is published in the ISPRS Journal of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing (2025, volume 230). Coverage: anywhere with Mapillary panoramas, with examples from Zurich, Orlando, Santiago, Montreal, Moscow and Vilnius. Access: free code. Licence: MIT. Caveats: labels are model predictions whose accuracy varies by region and image coverage. Simulation uses: filling missing building attributes for exposure models and stock energy models. Related records: NUS Global Streetscapes and Mapillary street-level imagery.
